risks.risk: Console identity (PS4 Fat vs Slim vs Pro) and storage size are not visible, so the price could be wrong.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the console model label/serial sticker (back/bottom) showing Fat/Slim/Pro and storage, plus a photo of the console itself (not the box).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst-case match among PS4 types (assume lowest-spec PS4) and treat as console-only until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Games and controller may not be included, may be different titles, or may be digital/bootleg rather than the claimed set.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of all 10 game discs (or cases) laid out, and a close-up photo of the controller(s) showing brand/label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as PS4 console with no confirmed games and no confirmed original pad.

risks.risk: Hacked/modified console risk (seller implies 'hacked' in words, but photos don’t confirm). Could have bans, unstable software, or missing features.
risks.proof: Ask for a video showing the console boot screen and the system settings page (including firmware version) plus a quick game load test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed to be clean/fully functional; assume worst-case software/usage issues.

risks.risk: Port faults, overheating, or power supply issues can’t be assessed from box photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a short test video: plug in HDMI + USB controller + (if possible) Ethernet, then show a game running for 10–15 minutes without shutdown/errors.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until a live test is shown.

risks.risk: Receipt/original accessories claim can’t be verified remotely.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the UK receipt and close-ups of the controller model/serial and any included cables.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the actual PS4 console (front/back/side) and the model label/serial sticker showing Fat/Slim/Pro and storage.
Send photos of the controller(s) (front/back close-ups) and confirm whether it’s original (label visible).
Send photos of all game discs/cases (10 items) laid out, matching the titles claimed.
Send a short video test: boot + system settings + loading a game + showing no overheating/shutdown for 10–15 minutes.
Send a photo of the UK receipt and all included cables (power/HDMI/USB).
response.reason: The photos only show PS4 packaging/box, not the console, controller, games, or any proof of functionality. Without the actual console identity and live test, a worst-case price cannot be chosen confidently.
